You curl a finger toward the unattended object. A thin spiral of wind catches it and draws it across the ground toward your hand.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Target / range / shape
One visible unattended object of up to Bulk 1 within 5 squares
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Utility

Cannot take worn or held objects, deal impact damage, open locks or carry creatures. Path must be clear; use ordinary terrain cost. Repeatable.

Weak
Pull it 1 square.
Standard
Pull it 3 squares.
Strong
Pull it 5 squares into your free hand if reachable.
